privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.description: Short, because Facet Review hardly processes any data: your data stays in your browser.

local.heading: Your data stays in your browser
local.body:
Facet Review is a web app without a server component. All project data – search documentation, imported records, screening decisions and checklists – is stored only locally in your browser (IndexedDB). Settings such as language, appearance, CSV delimiter and the optional e-mail address for OpenAlex are kept in the browser’s local storage (localStorage).

This data is not transferred to us or to third parties. There are no accounts, no cookies, no analytics or tracking tools and no externally loaded fonts or scripts.

hosting.heading: Hosting on GitHub Pages
hosting.body:
The app is delivered by GitHub Pages (GitHub Inc., USA) at facetreview.org. When you open the page, GitHub processes technically necessary connection data, in particular your IP address, to deliver the files and secure the service. This is not tracking by Facet Review. Details are governed by GitHub’s privacy statement.

[PLACEHOLDER: legal basis (e.g. Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR) and note on data transfer to the USA]

openalex.heading: Searching OpenAlex
openalex.body:
Only when you start an OpenAlex search yourself in the “Search” module does your browser send the search string and the chosen filters directly to the OpenAlex API (operated by OurResearch, USA); OpenAlex also receives your IP address. If you have entered an e-mail address or API key, these are sent along – both are voluntary and can be deleted at any time.

[PLACEHOLDER: legal basis and link to the OpenAlex privacy policy]

links.heading: Links to other sites
links.body: Links, e.g. to DOI, PubMed or Unpaywall, open these sites only when you click them. The privacy policies of those providers then apply.

csp.heading: Technical safeguard
csp.body: A Content Security Policy allows the browser to connect only to the app itself and to the OpenAlex API. The browser blocks all other connections.

deletion.heading: Deleting your data
deletion.body: You delete projects in the project overview. To remove all data, delete the site data of facetreview.org in your browser. Back up projects as a JSON file first if you want to keep them.
